content: {"like":["Values fresh, innovative takes on classic superhero lore, especially Batman, with new villains and character arcs; appreciates strong female leads and well-crafted villains; enjoys high-quality art, music, and animation that feel artistic and engaging; seeks unexpected plot twists and unique storytelling; prefers action-packed, well-structured narratives with clear character development."],"dislike":["Dislikes repetitive or overly long titles and redundant opening sequences; finds short segments and poor presentation frustrating; rejects classic villains and sidekicks that feel stale; avoids content with gratuitous raunchy or sexual references that distract from plot; dislikes overly dark or grim portrayals that undermine positive superhero themes."]}
